title: Determination of lease for nonpayment of rent
requirement: A landlord may terminate a written lease for nonpayment of rent only after giving the tenant 14 days' written notice to quit, and the tenant may avoid termination by tendering all rent due with interest and costs before the day the answer is due.
coverage_conditions: Written leases of residential premises where rent is not paid; the tenant may cure by paying all rent due, interest and costs.

applicability.per_tenancy: Nonpayment of rent under a written lease
coverage_quotes: Upon the neglect or refusal to pay the rent due under a written lease, fourteen days' notice to quit, given in writing by the landlord to the tenant, shall be sufficient to determine the lease

quoted_span: Upon the neglect or refusal to pay the rent due under a written lease, fourteen days' notice to quit, given in writing by the landlord to the tenant, shall be sufficient to determine the lease, unless the tenant, on or before the day the answer is due, in an action by the landlord to recover possession of the premises, pays or tenders to the landlord or to his attorney all rent then due, with interest and costs of suit.
